Today 2:00 AM (Australia/Brisbane), read-only Dots Astra update:

The strongest energy result now addresses the many-qubit gap: under explicit local loss, bounded excitation and coherent-transport assumptions, it bounds simultaneous fault amplitudes without a device-size factor. It allows a warm, correlated quantum source and keeps the other interactions running; it does not require private-sign pulses.

That proof has passed independent mathematical review. I’m checking the physical resource requirements and strongest existing noise-threshold results before claiming a useful hardware advantage.
